1.w: Praise the Lord, for it is good to sing praises to our God. Yes, praise is pleasant and appropriate.

2.w: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and gathers the exiles of Israel.

3.w: He heals the brokenhearted and bandages their wounds.

4.w: He counts the number of the stars; he names all of them.

5.w: Our Lord is great and has awesome power; there is no limit to his wisdom.

6.w: The Lord lifts up the oppressed, but knocks the wicked to the ground.

7.w: Offer to the Lord a song of thanks. Sing praises to our God to the accompaniment of a harp.

8.w: He covers the sky with clouds, provides the earth with rain, and causes grass to grow on the hillsides.

9.w: He gives food to the animals and to the young ravens when they chirp.

10.w: He is not enamored with the strength of a horse, nor is he impressed by the warrior’s strong legs.

11.w: The Lord takes delight in his faithful followers and in those who wait for his loyal love.

12.w: Extol the Lord, O Jerusalem. Praise your God, O Zion.

13.w: For he makes the bars of your gates strong. He blesses your children within you.

14.w: He brings peace to your territory. He abundantly provides for you the best grain.

15.w: He sends his command through the earth; swiftly his order reaches its destination.

16.w: He sends the snow that is white like wool; he spreads the frost that is white like ashes.

17.w: He throws his hailstones like crumbs. Who can withstand the cold wind he sends?

18.w: He then orders it all to melt; he breathes on it, and the water flows.

19.w: He proclaims his word to Jacob, his statutes and regulations to Israel.

20.w: He has not done so with any other nation; they are not aware of his regulations. Praise the Lord!
